text:
sara: deploybot just flagged a publish failure for redwood/runtime:canary-20260321-abc123 — ECR accepted the layers but the provenance guard rejected the attestation. can we hold the rollout?

deploybot: [automated] publish halted: provenance-attestation-missing-platform -> reject. job=ci/release/789 status=FAILED. see logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/789

bryan: logs? what exactly is missing from the attestation?

deploybot: error: attestation payload missing required field 'platform' for one or more manifests. policy=provenance-strict. full: "attestation missing org.opencontainers.image.platform"

chandra: this smells like the buildx -> cosign pipeline created an attestation only at the index level (manifest list) without per-arch attachments. our provenance validator expects per-platform attestation with platform.arch/os.

maria: can we re-run signing step only (no rebuild)? i think we can fetch the manifest list + platform-specific images, attach platform metadata and re-sign the existing digest.

bryan: alternative is to pin to previous successful digest and rollback the canary. that buys time but means no new fix in canary. what's the change window?

sara: change window is 30m. prefer to republish/resign if low-risk. re-signing + republish should be quick if we don't mutate layers. but need to be careful with cosign + KMS; we must produce attestation that includes platform entries.

chandra: plan i propose:
1) fetch manifest list and per-platform digests
2) generate small JSON attachments mapping platform -> digest (arch/os)
3) use cosign to add attestation attachments per-platform (or sign the per-platform image refs)
4) push the attestation to ECR/GCR (we mirror to both)
5) run provenance validator locally against the new attestation
6) un-hold deploybot

snippet:
```bash
# inspect manifest list
echo "manifest:" && aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name runtime --image-ids imageTag=canary-20260321-abc123 --query 'images[].imageManifest' | jq .
# pull per-platform digests (example)
skopeo inspect --raw docker://registry.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime:canary-20260321-abc123 | jq .manifests
# sign per-platform ref (example digest placeholder)
cosign sign --key ksm:alias/redwood/prod-ecr registry.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime@sha256:<platform-digest>
```

maria: i can run the cosign sign step using the KMS key. note: need to set COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 for attestation attachments in some versions. i will run locally and push attestation to staging ECR only.

ops: if you republish attestations, please mark the canary at 10% and bump after 1 successful minute per zone. i'll coordinate health checks.

bryan: if we fail to re-sign, we fallback to pinning: rollback to redwood/runtime@sha256:prevdigest and update release notes explaining the pin. that's my fallback.

sara: decision: go with re-sign + attest fix. maria and chandra to execute. deploybot will remain on hold until i ack. update release notes with short note: "Canary republish: corrected missing platform metadata in provenance attestation."

ci-bot: triggered job ci/repub/790 for attest-only re-sign (assigned to maria). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/repub/790

maria: starting now. will report back with signed digest and validation results.

chandra: i'll run local provenance validator against the new attestation: `./tools/provenance-check --image registry.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime@sha256:<digest>`

maria: ok signed and pushed. new attestation for platform aarch64 and amd64 attached to the same digests. validated locally, provenance-check OK. new attestation URL: s3://attestations/staging/repub-790.json

sara: thanks. ops please un-hold and start 10% canary (zones: us-west-2/ us-east-1). i'll watch release notes + metrics.

ops: un-holding now. canary started at 10%. will escalate to 50% after 3m if healthy. :thumbsup:

bryan: updating changelog/release notes: "2026-03-21 canary republish for missing platform annotation in provenance; no layer changes. tracked in #infra-provenance. revert plan: pin to previous digest if validator fails"

sara: closing thread once canary is green. thanks all.
